newsitem.title: KENYA: SOCCER-KENYA BEAT GUINEA IN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KENYA BEAT GUINEA IN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Kenya's Harambee Stars beat Guinea's Syli Stars 1-0 in their World Cup Group One qualifying match at the Moi International Sports Centre to revive their hopes of a shock appearance in the finals in France.
Kenya's group also includes Olympic champions and favourites Nigeria, who were playing away to Burkina Faso on Sunday.
Kenyan President Daniel arap Moi led 55,000 frenzied supporters who were rewarded with a third-minute goal from a penalty, slotted in by captain Musa Otieno.
"This is a young team and although going to France next year was not one of our major priorities, we can now say that possibility does exist," said Kenya's German coach Reinhardt Fabisch.

Kenya dominated the first half, with Mike Okoth Origi and forward Ken Simiyu coming close. Origi's shot was desperately cleared from the goal-line by defender Mohamed Sylla in the 12th minute and moments later goalkeeper Saliou Diallo saved from Simiyu.
Guinea captain Aboubacar Titi Camara, who plays for Lens in France, was outstanding and came close to an equaliser in the 82nd minute, his goalbound shot cleared from the line by Otieno.
A minute later, Camara failed to connect with a cross from Souleymane Oulare, with Kenyan goalkeeper Francis Onyiso well-beaten.
Kenya - Francis Onyiso, Vincent Kwarula, Eric Omondi, Josiah Ougo, John Lichuku, Musa Otieno, Eric Ochieng (Francis Were), Seleman Rashid, Mike Okoth, Ken Simiyu (Mike Mururi), John Odhiambo.

Guinea - Saliou Diallo, Mohamed Sylla, Souriba Sylla (Ousmane Soumah), Idrissa Diallo, Ousmane Fernandez, Souleymane Oulare, Aboubacar Titi Camara, Momo Wandel (Fode Camara), Ousmane Ngom, Abdulkarim Bangoura, Drame Sekou Oumar
